race.comment: PURPLE HAZE (12) consistent gelding ready to shed his Maiden tag at start nine. Strong through the line on resumption with a narrow second as fav over 1506m at Port Macquarie. Perfectly placed and is sure to take a ton of beating. FLY THE WIND (14) at her top for this fifth up and finds a much easier contest after tiring late when sixth over 1400m at Illawarra Grange. Should measure up with the key jockey change. WHOOPI DO (9) surprised at the big odds ($101), when she accounted for a Maiden field over 1300m at Newcastle in a Super Maiden. Aaron Bullock sticks and can handle the jump in trip. ATADCHEEKY (10) has his hoof on the till at start twelve after finishing close up at his last two runs. Circled the field from the outside draw with a slashing second over 1500m at Port Macquarie. Genuine contender.
